theme: Green high meadows and cool mornings - peak-summer Kashmir wide open as the July season begins
season: Peak summer (early July 2026) - flights landing in Srinagar, every pass and the Z-Morh tunnel open, the high meadows at Sonamarg and Pahalgam lush and green, gardens in full bloom and the Dal glass-still at dawn. The Amarnath Yatra begins 3 July, so the valley is busy and the season is at its height - a wide-open, easy time to visit.
campaign_name: Kashmir Green meadows and open valley [INR] - 02 Jul 2026
subject: The valley is green and wide open this July
